profile.headline: Data Services Software Engineer @ Roblox
profile.summary:
Looking to create the next big thing. 
I love working with other talented and driven individuals who are dedicated to building something great. So let’s make it happen! Time waits for no one.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Data Services
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon S3

positions.title: Founder, Project Lead
positions.description:
Using the Roblox platform to create games that reach millions of users every month.
Best known for the creation of Roblox Escape Room, I've led teams working on games that have reached a total of over 100 million players worldwide. As project lead and founder, I have worked to shape and bring our teams' visions into reality. I have organized partnerships alongside Roblox with companies such as Disney Pixar, Nickelodeon, and Warner Brothers to bring their brands into the metaverse through in-experience advertising and sponsored events. We've also partnered with Roblox and Jazwares to bring toys and merchandise based on our games to stores such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, and more around the world.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Product Management · Team Leadership · Game Design · Rust (Programming Language) · Community Engagement

positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Manager, Content Strategist
positions.description: I work on a freelance basis as brand manager and content strategist for the YouTube channel Dein0mite. I helped the owner to grow his channel from the ground up to 250k subscribers with over 27 million views as of 2024. I actively managed the channel's branding and social presence, monitoring analytics and the community to shape our approach to growing the channel and brand.
positions.insights: Skills: Content Strategy · Marketing · Product Management · Business Strategy · Social Media Marketing · Influencer Marketing

positions.title: SWE Intern | Core UI
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: As a member of the Core UI team at Roblox, I led the development of a new Report Abuse experience for the Universal App that supported a server-driven ui architecture and keyboard-less navigation. This project was a release candidate requirement for both the Meta VR and PlayStation platforms. This made it a critical project for the company since Roblox planned to announce their launches on these platforms at their annual developers conference that September. I collaborated closely with the Trust and Safety team to realize the new designs.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Lua · User Experience (UX) · User Interface Design

positions.title: SWE Intern | Personalization Team
positions.description: I joined the Personalization team where I took on two projects: the first, creating a new native-luau page for purchasing UGC products from the universal app; and for the second, I created a product spec and UX prototype for a user generated tags system for experiences, to be used in search and discovery.

positions.title: Developer Stars Partner
positions.description: A partnership with Roblox and Jazwares to produce and distribute toys using intellectual property from games and properties that I own and manage. We worked with Roblox and Jazwares to release new toys every year as a part of Roblox's various toy lines during the duration of this partnership.

positions.title: SWE Intern | Search and Discovery Team
positions.description:
I rejoined the team, now Search and Discovery, and spent the summer working on
designing and creating a prototype system that allowed developers to share the
latest news about their experiences with users through a “What’s New” feature and
the experience tile.

positions.description: I joined the Game Discovery team where I worked primarily in Lua/Luau, implementing design and UX improvements to the experience details page on Roblox’s Universal App.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Partner
positions.description: I partnered with Nickelodeon during 2018 to promote their televised event "The Kids' Choice Awards" in the video game I own and develop, Escape Room. This sponsorship was viewed and interacted with by over 2,000,000 users.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Partner
positions.description: I partnered with Disney and Pixar during 2017 to promote the release of their animated film "Coco" in the video game I own and develop, Escape Room. This sponsorship was viewed and interacted with by over 4,000,000 users.

projects.title: Roblox Escape Room
projects.description:
Between the years of 2017 to 2020, I lead a team of software engineers, graphic artists, and music producers in the production of an online Escape Room experience which attracted the attention of millions. Winning multiple awards on the Roblox platform including "Best Single Player Game of 2018" and "Most Challenging Game of 2017", Roblox Escape Room has reached an audience of millions around the world, attaining more than 100,000,000 unique play sessions. I partnered with companies such as Disney, Nickelodeon, and Warner Brothers through Roblox for multiple sponsored events on the Roblox platform, promoting their releases with custom Escape Rooms designed around their IP. The game had its own toy line launched between 2018 and 2020 through a partnership with Jazzwares and Roblox.

I have now turned this project into a business (Gen7Studios, LLC) as I move forward to professionally produce a brand new and modern sequel to Escape Room, releasing Q4 2023!
